# Locally bundled browser libraries

- PDF.js 6.4.299 — Apache-2.0 (`PDFJS-LICENSE.txt`)
- JSZip 3.10.2 — MIT (`JSZIP-LICENSE.txt`)
- jsQR 1.4.0 — Apache-2.0 (`JSQR-LICENSE.txt`)
- Tesseract.js 7.0.0 and Tesseract.js-core 6.1.2 — Apache-2.0 (`tesseract/TESSERACT-LICENSE.txt`, `tesseract/TESSERACT-CORE-LICENSE.txt`)
- English OCR data from `tesseract-ocr/tessdata_fast` — Apache-2.0 (`tesseract/TESSDATA-LICENSE.txt`)

These copies are served by this application. Scanning does not load code from a third-party CDN.
